subject: Short notice: temporary GPU slice for upcoming model release
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 3 Mar 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Short notice: temporary GPU slice for upcoming model release

Team — quick heads up. BlueWave (Samir) just confirmed a controlled demo for a buying committee on Tue 2028-03-07. They want to run a multi-client inference sweep (approx 3k simultaneous token streams over 2 hours) to validate tail latency and cost targets.

Product asks: can we carve a temporary GPU slice (medium priority) out of the US-West dedicated pool for Monday 03/06 09:00 - 21:00 PT and Tuesday 03/07 06:00 - 14:00 PT? This would be a one-off reservation tied to the BW pilot deal (BW-ENT-3742).

Key constraints:
- Burst must preserve existing SLAs for other Dedicated customers
- Autoscaling policy should relax scale-down aggressiveness only for the reserved slice (no global policy changes)
- We need an ops-runbook for failover to hosted variants if capacity contention occurs

Laura — can infra confirm whether a carve like this is feasible without causing preemptions? If not feasible, propose alternatives (shorter window, reduced concurrency).
Kimberly — please confirm if BlueWave procurement can sign a short addendum for guaranteed consumption for the windows.
Hannah — can you own the runbook + alerting for the reservation window?

I've attached a quick reserve_request_form and a rough capacity_estimate to this thread (placeholders).

Thanks,
Markus
Head of Product, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 3 Mar 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Short notice: temporary GPU slice for upcoming model release

Markus — thanks for the details. Quick feasibility check from infra:

What we can do right now (fast path):
- Carve a soft-reserve of approx 16 A40-equivalent slots in US-West for the two requested windows. Soft-reserve means priority routing to the slice but will allow eviction if there is a hard-capacity emergency.
- We can change the autoscaler profile for that slice to set min_replicas higher during the window and set scale_down_delay to 600s (10m) to avoid thrashing. This is slice-local and reversible.

Open questions before we finalize:
1) Exact concurrency (you listed 3k token streams — need expected RPS or steady-state concurrent sessions to size correctly).
2) Are we okay with soft-reserve semantics or do we require a hard guarantee (hard guarantees will require approval from Capacity and could take 48+ hours and contractual acknowledgement).
3) Who will be the on-call escalation if latency jumps above 95th percentile target? We can wire a temporary PagerDuty runbook.

If we proceed with soft-reserve I can spin up a prototype slice and the autoscaler changes in ~4 hours and provide telemetry. If we need a hard carve, I need confirmation by EOD and I'll open JIRA-INFRA-2198 for capacity approval.

-Laura
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: samir.khan@bluewavehealth.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: lindsey.park@bluewavehealth.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 3 Mar 2028 09:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Short notice: temporary GPU slice for upcoming model release

Samir — thanks for moving fast. BlueWave can confirm a short addendum for guaranteed consumption for the demo windows would make the hard carve request possible (and would help prioritize the approval). Two quick asks from procurement side:

1) Please confirm the nominal spend floor for the 2-day window (we estimate $X, see attached estimate).
2) Will there be any data residency constraints during the demo?

If procurement can sign a 48-hour addendum acknowledging the reserved window and spend floor, Laura says we can pursue a hard carve with capacity approvers. If not, we can proceed with the soft-reserve infra proposed.

Kimberly
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | kimberly_park@redwood.com
From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@bluewavehealth.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: lindsey.park@bluewavehealth.com
Date: Fri, 3 Mar 2028 10:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Short notice: temporary GPU slice for upcoming model release

Hi Kimberly / Markus — we can do an addendum. Answers:

- Spend floor: BlueWave confirms a provisional spend floor of $5,000 for the two windows (we need an itemized estimate from Redwood for internal procurement).
- Data residency: all demo data is anonymized; no special residency required for this test.

Samir
Samir Khan
Director of Data Science, BlueWave Health
samir.khan@bluewavehealth.com

All — good progress. Summary / decisions: 

- BlueWave (Samir) confirmed a provisional spend floor of $5,000 for the 2-day demo.
- Infra will create a soft-reserve slice (16 A40-eq) and apply slice-local autoscaler relaxation for the windows. Laura to open JIRA-INFRA-2198 for capacity visibility (no hard guarantee).
- Hannah to author the runbook + temporary PagerDuty escalation and post it to the Drive link below.
- Kimberly to share the addendum template and procurement contact info to finalize the spend ack.

Action items:

- hannah_schmitt: runbook + PD rotation config by 03/05 09:00 PT.
- kimberly_park: send addendum template to Samir and cc procurement (by EOD).
